row.body: The prevention sheet asks residents to store combustible supplies safely; the inspection card says the supply room was already sealed.
row.title: Storage advice and a locked room

sidecar.gloss: A storage room is sealed during a public safety check.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field team could seal a room during a routine safety inspection; the card does not say who ordered it.

row.body: the broom and fertilizer sack share a sweet pesticide smell. dead moths are stuck only where the two objects touched.
row.title: field residue on the broom

sidecar.gloss: A rare everyday object carries residue tied to field work before restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers crossing treated land could have picked up the same residue; the objects do not prove the farm program began the emergency.
